title: Flat-term successive quotient tensor sequence
statement: For a sheaf of commutative rings B and a section t whose multiplication is sectionwise injective, let R_j=B/t^jB. For n>1 and every cochain complex P of flat B-module sheaves, the ordinary scalar-extension complexes form a short exact sequence Res(R_(n-1) tensor_B P) to R_n tensor_B P to Res(R_1 tensor_B P) in cochain complexes of R_n-module sheaves. The first map sends [b] tensor x to [tb] tensor x, the second sends [b] tensor x to [b] tensor x. The quotient maps commute with the projections from B. The statement applies to any of the prescribed ordinary scalar-extension functor presentations. The quotient rings are [def-pe-principal-power-ring-quotients], scalar-extension presentations are those of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], flatness is [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and the endpoint actions use [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars].

proof.text: The sectionwise quotient maps give a short exact sequence of B-module presheaves, with multiplication [b] to [tb] and quotient [b] to [b]. Its exactness follows by cancellation of t and by quotient lifts. Exact module sheafification and the locally bijective quotient-ring units identify its terms with the actual ring-sheaf quotients restricted to B. The ring quotient transitions are induced from the sectionwise quotient factor maps and commute with the projections.

source.place: Second paragraph, the coefficient exact sequence; local quotient verification of its general ring-sheaf form.

proof.text: For the supplied complex P with flat terms, apply the sheafified tensor termwise to the coefficient sequence. The normalized coefficient maps are natural in P and commute with each differential. Thus they define the displayed cochain maps.

proof.text: Tensor the coefficient sequence with each flat term P^i using the exact-functor definition of sheaf flatness. Restricted ordinary scalar extension is canonically the sheaf tensor with the restricted coefficient ring, by the normalized presheaf tensor identity, the locally bijective tensor unit, and the sheafification universal property. Restriction along the locally surjective ring projection B to R_n recovers R_n-linear maps from their B-linear maps. It is exact and faithful, hence reflects the degreewise short exactness. Naturality in P^i gives cochain maps, and degreewise short exactness is short exactness of complexes.
